desk.headline: Filing covers board approval of 30 Sep 2026 accounts but gives no results figures; no guidance
results: This 24 Nov filing is a cover letter to the CNV and BYMA: the board approved the financial statements to 30 Sep 2026 that day.
It includes no profit, income or loan figures, so the quarter's results cannot be summarised from it.
Spain's BBVA remains the controlling shareholder, with 66.55% of the share capital; the bank has no convertible debt or share options.

guidance.summary: This filing gives no financial guidance.

call.source: No call coverage found: regulatory cover letter (Form 6-K)

watch: The full September-quarter results release, with profit and asset quality figures.

sources.title: Form 6-K — financial statements as of 30 Sep 2026 (CNV submission), 24 Nov 2026
